name: magic-ui-bento-grid
blurb: Responsive bento grid with icon cards and animated hover reveals.
description: A 3-column auto-row grid (BentoGrid) containing cards (BentoCard) with icons, names, descriptions, backgrounds, and CTA links. Cards animate on hover.
use_when: Feature showcases or capability matrices where bento asymmetry and icon-led design organize and prioritize information.
avoid_when: Content-light designs where bento complexity is unnecessary or where variable card heights could create usability confusion.
a11y: Cards are semantic containers with heading hierarchy. Icons pair with text. CTA links are keyboard accessible.
